query: For a 54-year-old female patient, what's the maximum length of stay in days for primary-diagnosis upper GI bleed (ages 49–59)?
final_sql: SELECT MAX(a.dischtime - a.admittime) AS max_length_of_stay FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 54 AND d.icd_code = 'G401' AND d.icd_version = '4';
